title: Contact Out Front (Michelle Grogan)
style: Latin pop and reggaeton fusion at 105 BPM in G minor. The track features a prominent dembow rhythm played on a crisp electronic drum kit with a punchy kick and sharp snare. A syncopated, staccato acoustic guitar riff provides the harmonic foundation, complemented by a deep, melodic sub-bass that follows the chord progression. Male and female vocals alternate and harmonize, utilizing modern pop production with light pitch correction and rhythmic doubling. A bright, synthesized brass section enters during transitions and instrumental breaks, playing staccato melodic stabs. Percussive elements include woodblocks and shakers that add high-frequency texture to the groove.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[drum fill, record scratch]
Contact them front, contact them front
Let the ball from the unit back
Early reach, early step
Meet the ball where you can see
[acoustic guitar riff, dembow beat enters]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals]
Eighteen inches in front of the chest
That's the contact point at best
The ball is past the body line
Defense only know design
¡Vamos, vamos! Meet it early
Uno, dos, tres, meet it surely
Split step on they swing
Feet popping you can sing

[Chorus]
[female vocals]
Meet it early
Meet it short
Meet it early
We indoor
[male and female vocals harmonize]
Contact out front, contact out front
[male vocals]
Meet, meet the ball, meet, meet the ball
[male and female vocals harmonize]
Contact out front, contact out front
[male vocals]
¡Vamos amigos!
[female vocals]
Meet it all

[Instrumental Break]
[staccato synth brass stabs, driving percussion]

[Verse 2]
[female vocals]
If it gets past the front line
Reset only, no design
Recover and breathe, count three
Next swing comes and we agree
[male vocals]
Uno, dos, tres, watch the scene
I know fear, I'm part of the beam
Predict the ball before they swing
Contact early is the king
Late contact just the loser
Eighteen inches early is the user
Breath count three, reset eyes
Next ball, next ball, your prize

[Chorus]
[male and female vocals harmonize]
Contact out front, contact out front
[male vocals]
Meet, meet the ball, meet, meet the ball
[male and female vocals harmonize]
Contact out front, contact out front
[male vocals]
¡Vamos amigos!
[female vocals]
Meet it all

[Outro]
[acoustic guitar solo, percussion continues]
Meet it early
Eighteen inches
Meet it early
Eighteen inches
[brass stabs, fade out]
